palette.sky: #2B2A5C indigo zenith grading through #7A5AA0 violet to #E58AA0 alpenglow rose at the ridge (ski and compressor exteriors)
palette.ground: #F2E6D2 warm paper snow with #8E8AB8 lilac shadow planes; the workbench world is #D9A441 mustard felt under a #FFF4DC lamp pool; the kitchen is #3A2A44 plum night with a #F6B65A amber window
palette.hero: #5FD6B8 mint jelly, shade #1E8C7A, cream highlight #F4FFF9, ink #14213D
palette.mood: a blue-hour Interior of lilac snow and a warm mustard workbench where a mint jelly learns shapes, alarm red only where something does not fit

roles.alarm red #FF4D2E: only where a real thing does not match Norm's remembered shape: the boot's toe, the trace that leaves the band. At most one red element per frame, and none on the rose-lit ski slope or in any frame where the rose ridge is the background.
roles.mint #5FD6B8: Norm's jelly only. No readout, lamp or chip is mint.
roles.mustard felt #D9A441: the workbench and the 2019 desk only
roles.brass #C99A3C: the ANCHOR button and the clipboard clip only
roles.navy #14213D: ink, plates and the paper test set
roles.alpenglow rose #E58AA0: the ridge light and the ski slope shadow only

palette.diverges_from_last_two: 10-17 was a low peach sun over Interior snow with cobalt shadows and warm plaster interiors, hero cyan, hazard orange alerts, deep navy cutaways. 10-16 was a black-spruce night, midnight teal and tungsten amber with an alarm vermilion. This film is a blue-hour indigo to violet to rose sky over lilac snow, a warm mustard felt workbench and a plum night kitchen, a mint jelly hero and a signal red used once per frame only on a mismatch. HONEST OVERLAP: signal red #FF4D2E sits near 10-16's vermilion #E0453A in role (one alert color), mint #5FD6B8 is a neighbouring blue-green to 10-17's cyan #25C7E8 hero (the mint is greener and warmer and never glows), and navy ink is shared by every film.

light.time_of_day: blue hour for the ski slope and the compressor yard, a lamp pool over the workbench, a plum night kitchen with an amber window
light.direction: workbench: key from a lamp at upper left, mustard bounce; slope: low rose sun right of frame, lilac fill from the snow; kitchen: amber window right, plum fill; paper test set: flat overhead with a clipboard lamp
light.intent: key=lamp or low rose sun, fill=lilac snow bounce or plum, rim=cream on the lit side, Norm gets a translucent mint glow on the side away from the key
light.depth: Workbench: far felt wall drifts 8 px, table edge 16 px, Norm 1.0, foreground boot/tools drift 22 px. Slope: ridge 8 px, tree row 16 px, slope 1.0, near drift fence 24 px. Kitchen: wall 8, counter 16, hero 1.0, chair-less near plane of a rug and cable at y1500. Compressor yard: pipe run parallax 0.5, twin ghost 1.0. Paper and inspection sets (shots 2, 11, 12): wall grid static, hero 1.0, a floor perspective ruling and drifting dust as the near plane at y1500 and below. Compressor yard: far ridge 8 px, lilac ground, compressor and twin 1.0, snow ellipses and a pipe run as the near plane.

shape_language: SOFT ROUND JELLY (Norm, a wobbling dome with a flat base) against HARD ANGULAR things that press into him: a ski boot, a compressor block, a wall button, a phone, a clipboard. Norm is the only soft object in a hero frame; every prop that touches him has a corner.

casting.hero: Norm (net-new, lib/norm.tsx). dedupe.py check --hero Norm returned FRESH. Not ReserveBar or SeismicStation, the last two heroes.

kit_used.Norm: hero, the machine that learns normal

casting.hero_state: blank and wobbling at 0 s, boot-dented grinning at 4 s, red-browed on the mismatch at 9 s, ski-turn dented at 38 s, routine ring with a red segment at 60 s, heartbeat-dented under the $54B tag at 82 s, unset and wobbling under the lamp at 92 s, set in the 2019 mold at 115 s, blank and facing camera at 125 s
casting.net_new_reason: the shelf has no soft deformable hero that holds an imprint of another object; Norm is reusable for any learn-normal-then-flag story (to be registered in ASSET_MANIFEST.md)

motion_language: nothing linear: Norm squashes and rebounds with springs and keeps a continuous wobble, dents form with an ease and a small overshoot, the boot drops with anticipation, the phone buzzes, the clipboard stamps ring; Norm idles with blinks, a slow breath, a jelly shimmer and a brow that tells the state.

composition.focal_hierarchy: one lit object per shot; Norm is the best-finished thing in every frame he is in; the near plane in the lower third carries a boot, a rug and cable, snow drifts or the felt table edge
composition.negative_space: the paper test set (shots 10 and 11) is deliberately plain so the clipboard and the cards carry it
composition.safe_area: hero action inside y 420 to 1320, caption band 1336 to 1472 clear of hero motion, a near plane at 1475 and below
composition.signature_shot: a blank mint jelly under a lamp with a boot-shaped dent already in his forehead, the real boot pressed back into it, and one corner of the boot glowing alarm red where it does not fit

craft_advance: none required; norm.tsx is a reusable deformable-imprint hero
world_values: mid-dark: slope and yard (indigo to rose), plum kitchen and plan, navy inspection table; mid-light: mustard felt workbench; light: cream paper test set. Cuts between the dark worlds and the felt bench ride Norm (the one mint object) and the lamp pool.
